meta.title: Static Site Generator
meta.description: Install the static site generator plugin and seed a richer demo site.
meta.author: Adam Zielinski

steps.command:
wp post create --post_type=page --post_status=publish --post_title='About the Static Demo' --post_name=about-static-demo --post_content='

About the Static Demo

This page exists to verify that static exports render real page content, not the homepage.

  • Pages
  • Dated posts
  • Linked archive content
'

wp post create --post_type=page --post_status=publish --post_title='Projects' --post_name=projects --post_content='

Projects

A second page with separate content for static export verification.

'

wp post create --post_type=post --post_status=publish --post_title='Hello World Field Report' --post_name=hello-world --post_date='2026-03-11 10:00:00' --post_content='

Hello World Field Report has unique dated-post content for export verification.

Dated permalinks should render this post, not the homepage.

'

wp post create --post_type=post --post_status=publish --post_title='Gallery Launch Notes' --post_name=gallery-launch-notes --post_date='2026-03-12 10:00:00' --post_content='

Gallery Launch Notes

This second post confirms that multiple dated post pages export independently.

'

wp post create --post_type=post --post_status=publish --post_title='Archive Deep Dive' --post_name=archive-deep-dive --post_date='2026-03-13 10:00:00' --post_content='

Archive Deep Dive gives the demo enough content for archives and same-site links.
